mapper.sql: c.run_id, c.scheduler_version, c.plan_generation, c.defer_reason, c.next_visible_at, c.coordination_served_round, c.coordination_missed_rounds, c.dispatch_served_round, c.dispatch_missed_rounds, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_coordination (run_id, scheduler_version, plan_generation) SELECT r.id, r.scheduler_version, COALESCE(r.plan_generation, -1) FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId} ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination SET defer_reason = NULL, next_visible_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, coordination_served_round = #{roundNumber}, coordination_missed_rounds = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND coordination_served_round < #{roundNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_coordination c JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = c.run_id WHERE c.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND r.status IN () ORDER BY c.coordination_served_round, c.next_visible_at, c.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination c SET coordination_missed_rounds = c.coordination_missed_rounds + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = c.run_id AND r.status IN () AND c.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND c.coordination_served_round < #{roundNumber}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination c SET dispatch_missed_rounds = c.dispatch_missed_rounds + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = c.run_id AND r.status IN () AND c.dispatch_served_round < #{roundNumber} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi WHERE wi.run_id = c.run_id AND wi.state IN ('RUNNABLE', 'RESUMABLE') AND wi.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
